name: WrenAI
title_zh: 问一句人话，吐回带血缘的可信 SQL 和图表
tagline_zh: 别让业务等数仓排期了。它把自然语言翻成带治理上下文的 SQL，跨 20+ 数据源直出仪表盘——但每一步都留痕。
tagline_en: Stop waiting on data-warehouse tickets. It turns plain questions into governed SQL & dashboards across 20+.
desc_en: GenBI (Generative BI) for AI agents, an open-source, governed text-to-SQL through an open context layer that turns natural-language questions into trusted dashboards, charts, and SQL across 20+ data sources, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Amazon Redshift, Databricks and more.
why_zh: 不是裸的 text-to-SQL。它先建一层开放的 context layer，把指标口径。
why_en: Not bare text-to-SQL. It pins metrics & table relationships in an open context layer first, then agents generate on top—asking.
limit_zh: 只认已接入的 20+ 数据源；没配好的 context layer 它不会开工。产出到 SQL、图表、看板为止。
limit_en: Only works with its 20+ pre-integrated sources; won't start without a configured context layer. Output ends at SQL/charts/dashboards—no.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Ask in plain words, get governed SQL & charts back
